The row was admitted on an instruction the person gave, it carries its own checkpoint, and the definition of done here is decidable without making the person the checker — `python3 scripts/plan_checks.py` exits 0 and names each rewritten row, and the regenerated board page is the rendered surface the receipt would carry via `--surface`. Nothing in the state matches the three cases rule 12/27 reserves for him: it is not a taste call, there is no trade-off an artifact cannot settle, and it is not an open fork over the definition of correct — he settled that fork himself when he ordered plain-language titles, so carrying it out is executing his decision, not making one. It is also not an irreversible action outside git. Waiting for him to look at what was already shown and bless it is exactly the hold the procedure forbids; the fact that it is night where he is changes nothing, since the pipeline closes and continues without waiting for his attention. If he disagrees with the wording afterward, that is a new fact that becomes its own task carrying his correction, and this row stays closed.
